pick/scores: To generate text, the model scores every possible next token. Here there are three: cat, dog and fish, with scores two, one and zero.
pick/probs: Softmax turns the scores into probabilities: zero point six seven, zero point two four, and zero point zero nine.
pick/greedy: Greedy decoding always takes the most likely token: cat, every single time. That is safe, but the text comes out dull and repetitive.
pick/sample: Sampling draws at random with those probabilities instead: cat two times in three, dog about one in four, and now and then, fish.
temp/formula: A temperature, T, tunes how adventurous sampling is: divide every score by T before the softmax.
temp/low: With T at one half, the scores double to four, two and zero. The gaps grow, and cat takes zero point eight seven: sharper, closer to greedy.
temp/high: With T at two, the scores halve. The gaps shrink, and the probabilities flatten: zero point five one, zero point three one, and zero point one nine.
temp/order: Either way, the order never changes: cat stays on top. Temperature only changes how often the others get picked.
temp/limits: Push T toward zero and cat takes everything: that is greedy decoding. Push it ever higher, and every token gets the same share.
